text: Westport Albion regain possession near the center of the pitch through Kian Castillo’s interception. He directs a sequence of quick, vertical passes advancing steadily towards the left half of Kingsmoor FC’s penalty area. Castillo then plays a short pass to Rafael Delacroix, positioned about 4 metres from the near left post of the goal at the far end. Delacroix strikes confidently with his foot, scoring to bring the score to Kingsmoor FC 2, Westport Albion 1. [#391] [#398] [#401]
